description: This file implements the CalculatorHistory class, which manages a history of calculation items including adding, removing, retrieving, and clearing history entries. It also includes a helper function to generate expressions from tokens.

classes.name: CalculatorHistory
classes.description: A class that manages a history of calculator operations, allowing addition, removal, retrieval, and clearing of history items.

methods.name: CalculatorHistory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the maximum history size.

methods.name: AddToHistory
methods.description: Adds a new calculation entry to the history, including tokens, commands, and result.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds a pre-constructed history item to the history list, managing size constraints.

methods.name: RemoveItem
methods.description: Removes a history item at the specified index.

methods.name: GetHistory
methods.description: Returns the current list of history items.

methods.name: GetHistoryItem
methods.description: Retrieves a specific history item by index.
